title: Coupon engine
tagline: A ₹300 order can't use the ₹300-minimum coupon, BIG20 takes off too much, and one person's use blocks everyone.
lookFor: A percent discount with a limit: `Math.min(total * pct / 100, max)`.
'Once per user' must count by user. Check every `count({...})`.
'Valid until Dec 31' means until the END of Dec 31.

bugs.symptom: Order of exactly ₹300 can't use WELCOME50

bugs.cause: The ₹200 limit is written down but never used.

bugs.symptom: Second user is told they already used WELCOME50
hints: What does the count filter on?
bugs.cause: It counts uses of the code by anyone, so after one person uses it, nobody else can.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: Coupon expires at 00:00 on its last day
hints: `Date.parse('2026-12-31')` is which moment of that day?
bugs.cause: It's midnight at the START of Dec 31, so the coupon stops working a day early.
